clean.root_cause: Agent attempted to open cabinet 1 but the action did not change its state (cabinet remained closed) and it did not attempt any further actions.
clean.evidence: last action: open cabinet 1 -> obs: 'You arrive at cabinet 1. The cabinet 1 is closed.'
clean.corrective_rule: If an open action fails to open a container, try a different container or use look/examine to verify state.
clean.skill_tree_gap: No handling for failed open actions; agent lacks fallback strategy.
clean.patch_location: ## Action Execution (add new subsection ### Handling Failed Open Actions)

clean.root_cause: Agent only searched fridge and a few cabinets/drawers, failing to locate the tomato in other possible locations like countertops or sink.
clean.evidence: After opening fridge saw apple and lettuce, then opened cabinets 1-4 and drawer 1, none contained tomato.
clean.corrective_rule: Search all accessible surfaces and containers (including countertops, sink, diningtable) before concluding the object is missing.
clean.skill_tree_gap: Lack of systematic search covering all object types.
clean.patch_location: ## Exploration (add new subsection ### Comprehensive Container Search)

cool.root_cause: Agent searched only fridge and cabinets 1-5, missing the apple which might be in other cabinets or objects.
cool.evidence: Opened fridge (bread, plate, potato), then cabinets 1-4 (mostly empty or unrelated objects), and stopped at cabinet 5 without opening it properly.
cool.corrective_rule: Explore all cabinets and also check countertops, tables, and other surfaces for the target object.
cool.skill_tree_gap: Incomplete search strategy; not all containers are visited.

heat.root_cause: Agent searched only fridge and cabinets 1-4, failing to find the egg in other containers.
heat.evidence: Fridge had bread and plate; cabinets 1-4 had peppershaker, nothing, cup; cabinet 5 open failed.
heat.corrective_rule: Expand search to include all containers (drawers, shelves, countertops) to locate the egg.
heat.skill_tree_gap: Lack of comprehensive search across all object types.
heat.patch_location: ## Exploration (add new subsection ### Comprehensive Container Search)

pick_and_place.root_cause: Agent searched only cabinets 1-5 and encountered a failed open, never finding a mug or attempting to heat it.
pick_and_place.evidence: Opened cabinets 1-5 found saltshaker, ladle; last open cabinet 6 failed with 'cabinet 6 is closed'.
pick_and_place.corrective_rule: Search all possible locations including drawers, countertops, and shelves; also consider that the mug might need to be taken from a specific appliance.
pick_and_place.skill_tree_gap: Insufficient search scope; missing exploration of non-cabinet containers.
pick_and_place.patch_location: ## Exploration (add new subsection ### Comprehensive Container Search)

pick_two_obj_and_place.root_cause: Agent looked only in cabinets and drawers, missing the shelf where cups are likely located (as per successful trajectory).
pick_two_obj_and_place.evidence: After look, went to cabinet 1, 2, etc., and opened drawers; never visited shelf.
pick_two_obj_and_place.corrective_rule: When searching for objects, include all container types (shelves, tables, etc.) as indicated by the successful example.
pick_two_obj_and_place.skill_tree_gap: Agent lacks knowledge that objects can be on shelves; search strategy is too narrow.
